name: Noto (Italy)
description: Maroon (carmine red) field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Noto: a black eagle bearing a shield with a white cross on red, beneath a yellow crown, with S.P.Q.N. beneath.
history: Municipal flag of Noto, a comune in Sicily; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Noto arms — black eagle bearing a shield with a white cross on red, crowned
